source_status.exact_result: Actual counterexample on the prescribed unit-weight cyclic triangle squared in Z^2 direct sum Z^2: rho=|x1|+|y1|+|x2|+|y2|, h=|x1-x2|+|y1-y2|, gamma=max(h,rho/4-1), u=max(1-10rho,0). Gamma is positive-growth rational-domain real PA and actual PC; the raw envelope is exactly gamma, is PAPC and explicitly regularizable, and its complete recursive contact integral is -8. This refutes the all-data triangle-square contact assertion, including the proposed conditional PAPC-domain contact gate.
